Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.

Route.description: How a consent prompt reaches the approver: `wake` pushes to the approver's device for a DID-signed decision; `bridge-relay` renders it through an enrolled bridge (e.g. a numbered card in the operator's messaging app) for a bridge-attested decision.

schema.description: An admin binds the operator who approves inbound-messaging consent for a platform within a context.

approver.description: VID of the operator authorized to decide consent.

context.description: The VTA context path this binding applies to.

route.description: How the prompt reaches the approver; defaults to bridge-relay.

routeHint.description: Optional routing detail (e.g. the operator's opaque conversationRef).
